schedule_design.method: One GitHub run every 30 minutes. For each finalist, anchor to the latest 5-minute candle that Bithumb actually returned as closed, then map the preceding five exact 5-minute buckets. Missing/no-trade buckets stay missing; no stale-candle substitution.
schedule_design.anchor_freshness_rule: latest actual closed 5m candle must be no more than 10 minutes stale for A/B+ eligibility
schedule_design.orderbook_tradeflow_method: Current live orderbook/trade flow plus persisted prior 30-minute-run deltas; historical 5-minute orderbooks cannot be retroactively backfilled from the public API.

professional_decision_contract.probability_rule: Scores and grades are not calibrated probabilities; numeric probability claims require prospective calibration.
